name: Should I paint interior trim myself or hire a pro?

mainEntity.name: Should I paint interior trim myself or hire a pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you are deciding between DIY and professional trim painting, the main difference is time, precision, and final smoothness. DIY can work for a small room, but larger homes, detailed molding, or older trim usually benefit from professional prep and application. In Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, and Parker, it also helps to choose a local crew that can schedule around your home’s layout and access needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY can work for small, simple trim jobs, but pros are usually better for detailed or whole-home projects. If you want crisp lines and less cleanup, hiring is usually the safer choice.
